The '''Deputy Director of Operations for New Republic Intelligence''', or simply the '''Deputy Director of Operations''', was a position in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Intelligence Service|Intelligence Service]] under the [[Director of New Republic Intelligence]]. [[Belindi Kalenda]] held this position at the onset of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
